# Reused Khachiyan library

This directory preserves the 34 Lean sources from the recorded first-paper
development. New code uses the `SharpCut` namespace; these files retain
`Khachiyan` and their original mathematical content.

See [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json) for the source commit and file hashes,
and [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the author-confirmed MIT attribution. The build
requires no access to the original working directory.
